title: 3D/4D Ultrasound
content: Experience advanced imaging with our state-of-the-art 3D/4D ultrasound technology for detailed and dynamic views of your health. Our skilled technicians ensure a comfortable and precise examination.

title: Digital X-Ray
content: Our digital X-ray services ensure quick, accurate, and high-resolution imaging for precise diagnostics. We prioritize patient safety with minimal radiation exposure.

title: Laboratory
content: Our fully equipped laboratory offers a comprehensive range of tests with accurate and timely results. We utilize modern technology to support your health needs.

title: Physiotherapy
content: Benefit from personalized physiotherapy sessions designed to enhance recovery and improve mobility. Our therapists use evidence-based practices for optimal outcomes.

title: 24/7 Emergency Services
content: Our emergency department is open 24/7, providing immediate and expert care during critical situations. Our dedicated and skilled team is always ready to respond to any emergency.

title: Pharmacy
content: Our in-house pharmacy stocks a wide range of medications and healthcare products for your convenience. Our pharmacists provide expert advice on medication management.

title: Ambulance Facilities
content: Our efficient ambulance services ensure rapid and safe transportation in emergency situations. We are equipped with advanced life-saving equipment to provide immediate care en route.
